The World Bank's March 2023 regional brief says 'the 2020 Smart Rwanda Masterplan is dated' while Rwanda follows a whole-of-government approach to public-sector digital transformation; it gives no end date or successor, and the 'expired' value rests on the plan's 2020 name and the word 'dated'.

The joint ICT sector review of 26 October 2023 lists Smart Rwanda Master Plan II, a five-year ICT strategy with digital government, digital business and digital citizen pillars, among the 'policies under development'.

The review says the Ministry of ICT and Innovation, 'supported by the Rwanda Digital Acceleration project under World Bank', is working on the policies under development, which include Smart Rwanda Master Plan II.
The review names the Smart Rwanda Master Plan I as covering 2016-2020.
